bib.title: Visual SKETCHPAD: Sketching as a Visual Chain of Thought for Multimodal Language Models

read.skipped: Reference list skimmed; NeurIPS checklist skimmed

question: Can giving a multimodal LM a visual sketchpad (code-drawn lines, plots and specialist-vision overlays) that it reasons over improve performance on math and visual reasoning tasks?
hypothesis: Letting the LM draw intermediate visual artifacts and plan from them, as humans sketch, improves reasoning over text-only chain of thought or fixed tool pipelines.
contributions: Sketchpad framework: Thought/Action/Observation loop with multimodal observations, no training
Tools: matplotlib/networkx/chess for math; detection, segmentation, depth, sliding window, zoom, overlay for vision
Gains and SOTA on 4 math task families and 7 vision tasks
Analysis: human-plan agreement, tool usage, comparison to SoM and Visprog, open-source oracle test

method.summary: An AutoGen-based agent loop where a closed multimodal LM writes Python code (Action) from a tool-signature prompt, executes it, and sees the resulting images (Observation) before the next Thought, ending with a Terminate action. No fine-tuning.
method.task: geometry and IsoBench math reasoning; BLINK, V*Bench and MMVP visual reasoning

datasets.name: Geometry3K
datasets.preprocessing: diagram plus its matplotlib code given as input

datasets.name: BLINK Relative Depth / Spatial / Jigsaw / Visual Corr. / Semantic Corr.

other.use: oracle Sketchpad: given the last visual artifact from GPT-4o+Sketchpad

inference.prompting: System prompt plus tool-signature/docstring prompt, six in-context examples (vision prompt), user request; model emits THOUGHT/ACTION code blocks, ANSWER: ... TERMINATE. Same template for all vision tasks; math prompts drop vision tools and add plotting examples.

parameters.sliding_window: window 1/3 of image size, step 2/9, 4x4=16 windows

baselines: same GPT-4o / GPT-4 Turbo without Sketchpad
Gemini-Pro, Claude 3 Opus, Mixtral 8x7B, LLaMA-2-70B (text only, math)
SoM, SoM + original image, Visprog (GPT-4 swapped in)
eval.protocol: Single run per item as far as stated; no error bars, seeds or significance tests; gains are absolute accuracy points (Table 1 and 2 deltas equal differences of printed accuracies).

prompts.text: You are a helpful multimodal AI assistant. [MORE INSTRUCTIONS ...]

limits: Sketchpad needs more compute than direct language output (Appendix E: about 11-27k tokens per vision sample, $0.06-0.13 with GPT-4o).
Only off-the-shelf closed LMs; training the models to sketch is future work.
No seeds, error bars or significance tests; decoding settings, temperature and max turns not stated.
Abstract headline 12.7% math gain is not reproduced by the body (11.2% GPT-4o, 23.4% GPT-4 Turbo); averages are unweighted over tasks of different size.
Open-source test is an oracle: LLaVA sees GPT-4o's final sketch, it does not sketch itself.
Most plan errors come from vision specialist failures or simple VQA mistakes.
GPT-4 Turbo got worse on one math task (-9.0 in Table 1).
